g.text: Ratio of estimated mean hourly melEDI (log scale)
Dashed line: null ratio 1; points and bars: estimates and participant-cluster HC3 95% confidence intervals
Primary and contextual mean hourly melEDI ratios
The primary near-eye row is the prespecified analysis; chest, paired-day, and
gap-timing-unaware rows provide placement and data context.
Only primary and gap-sensitivity near-eye estimates carry their declared multiplicity
adjustment in the report table; no significance encoding is applied here.
